sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः ।
स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः ॥ ६-१॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
anāśritaḥ karmaphalaṃ kāryaṃ karma karoti yaḥ
sa saṃnyāsī ca yogī ca na niragnirna cākriyaḥ 6-1
translation: The Blessed Lord said: He who performs his bounden duty without depending on the fruits-of-actions — he is a SAMNYASIN and a YOGIN ; not he who (has renounced) is without fire and without action.
